features:
Key Features:

Bold Cheddar Flavor: A rich, cheesy seasoning coats each piece, combining the taste of cheddar, garlic, and onion.

Crunchy Variety: A blend of corn Chex, wheat Chex, pretzels, rye chips, and mini breadsticks offers a mix of textures in every bite.

Less Fat than Chips: Contains around 60% less fat than regular potato chips, making it a lighter alternative.

Ready to Eat: No preparation required—perfect for lunchboxes, road trips, or movie nights.

Multiple Pack Sizes: Available in individual pouches and family-sized bags.

Benefits:

Flavor-Packed Snacking: Delivers bold, savory flavor without being overly greasy.

Satisfying Texture: The mix of shapes and crunch keeps snacking interesting and enjoyable.

On-the-Go Friendly: Portable and resealable options make it easy to carry and store.

Family-Friendly Choice: Loved by both kids and adults; ideal for parties or casual gatherings.

Lighter Option: Lower fat content offers a guilt-reduced way to enjoy salty snacks.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Whole Wheat, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (soybean, palm, high oleic soybean and/or high oleic canola), Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Whey, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Sour Cream (cultures, nonfat milk, cream), Yeast, Yeast Extract, Baking Soda, Onion Powder, Cheddar Cheese (milk, salt, cultures, enzymes, annatto extract [for color]), Distilled Monoglycerides, Color (annatto extract, yellow 6, yellow 5 lake), Sodium Sulfite, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Calcium Carbonate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by BHT and TBHQ.
